title: Cloud Sync
summary: Monitor temperature, humidity, energy & more in real-time with Cloud Sync.
description:
Cloud Sync helps in monitoring real-time temperature, humidity, energy, and other sensor values for connected devices. It enables users to track device status, setPoint control operations, and receive alerts when assets exceed thresholds.

Key Highlights:
Get notified when assets exceed set thresholds.
Access historical data and insights for better decision-making.
Supports Modbus-based controllers.
View real-time sensor values remotely.
Easily track multiple assets.
